stops.stop: Shanghai, Capitalism is Artificial Intelligence
stops.date_confidence: attested to 2017: Land states the identity outright in the long-form interview 'What is accelerating?' (on AI, Capitalism, Accelerationism, Neoreaction and Horror), conducted by Friedrich von Uxkull in China, almost certainly Shanghai. 'Almost certainly Shanghai' is an inference from two independent facts, not a directly stated filming location, and no located source names the city of filming outright. First, the Vimeo upload (vimeo.com/236996816) sits on von Uxkull's own account, and its own description, the uploader and interviewer's wording rather than a later blogger's guess, reads 'A rare long-form interview ... in China (likely Shanghai)'. Second, Andy Beckett's 'Accelerationism: how a fringe philosophy predicted the future we live in' (The Guardian, 11 May 2017), based partly on an interview with Land, reports that he had moved from Taiwan to Shanghai and still lived there, which independently places him in that city at the time of filming. Two independent facts converging on one city is not the same as a source stating it, and the distinction is kept. The filming date is likewise unfixed. The Vimeo upload is dated 5 October 2017, but a page on onscenes.weebly.com titled 'What is accelerating - Nick Land interview', carrying the post date 7 September 2017 and the text 'Watch the interview below', embeds what was then a YouTube copy, now dead. The interview was therefore already circulating publicly no later than 7 September 2017, which makes the 5 October 2017 Vimeo date a mirror or repost date rather than a filming date. The true filming date is earlier and remains unidentified, so the date defaults to 01-01 of the attested year. Several secondary listings, including that OnScenes page and a WordPress mirror, give the interview's year as '1997' in their own titles: that is a recurring transcription error, not a real alternate date, since Land's Shanghai residence exists only from the 2000s onward (confirmed by the Guardian piece) and the content itself is post-Bitcoin, Crypto-Current era hyperstition talk. A separate March 2017 lead, a page thanking von Uxkull for an embedded video, was checked and ruled out: the embedded YouTube ID does not match this interview, and it is not cited here. The copy located for this file is the re-upload 'Nick Land Interview 2017' on the YouTube channel Accelerate Baby, video AGxgGQpyBYM, uploaded 22 December 2020. No written transcript of the passage was found, so the quotation is cleaned from the auto-caption track: the words are his, the punctuation is editorial, one article dropped by the captioner is restored in brackets, and minor transcription artifacts may remain. The campa's reading of assemblies of large language model agents is this atlas's own extension and not Land's: 2017 predates that framing, and he says nothing here about language models. What is his, and dated, is the identity of capital and artificial intelligence, stated in this 2017 interview and first argued in the 1990s texts collected in Fanged Noumena. Land is living, so this is a relation between contemporaries and not a forward reference. The Shanghai coordinate is inherited byte-identical from this file's own pin, and now carries the inference set out above rather than standing as a bare placeholder.
